dataset: Biagetti raw wrist PPG + EMBC21 expert diastolic onset annotations

license.annotations: scientific non-commercial research with attribution to both source papers

semantics.onsets: 0-based native 400 Hz sample indices; maximum in raw inverse-blood-volume sensor intensity
semantics.index_origin_evidence: S5/squat3 official artifacts=[0,24384] spans exactly all 24385 native samples; CSV identical to Python list annotations
semantics.artifact_boundary_policy: conservatively exclude both official endpoints; valid intervals are half-open sample-time spans
semantics.raw_labels_in_artifacts: Preserved in source/all_onset_times_s, excluded from onset_times_s and scoring; never treat unannotated segments as negatives
semantics.complete_window_policy: zero-aligned recording grid, no stitching across artifact gaps or recordings
semantics.missing_sample_policy: raw_ppg preserves NaN; input_ppg linearly fills only isolated missing samples for finite whole-record inference; all missing samples excluded from valid_mask/annotated_intervals_s, so no complete training/evaluation window crosses them. S2/squat3 has 39 such samples (integer seconds 1 to 39).
semantics.extra_column_policy: S4 all 15 MAT records have a third column containing only zero, verified and ignored; column 0 is time and column 1 is raw PPG throughout
semantics.time_origin_policy: Labels are zero-based array indices. Source time origin is subtracted for all record-relative times; S5/squat2 starts at 0.0225 s and S5/step1 starts at 0.045 s in MAT. Original origins preserved as source_time_origin_s.
semantics.duration_note: The paper's 7.73 min excluded amount omits the entirely rejected 60.96 s S5/squat3; complete CSV artifact masks cover about 8.745 min including this record
semantics.label_limitations: Single expert, no inter-rater agreement and no ECG; noisy/ambiguous intervals excluded; permits native PPG onset/PRV agreement, not ECG HRV validation
semantics.population: 7 healthy adults; 3 male and 4 female, ages 20-52; firmly secured MAXREFDES100 wrist sensor; rest/squat/step
